name: com.getroomproof/roomproof
title: Roomproof
description: Room planning to scale from your AI: it places furniture, Roomproof checks walkways and door swings.

tools.name: read_product
tools.description: Free, no key. Turns a product link (IKEA, any furniture shop) or the pasted text of a product page into real dimensions: name, width_mm, depth_mm, height_mm, price, link. Call it as soon as the user gives a furniture link. On success pass name, width_mm, depth_mm, height_mm, price and link unchanged into a custom piece in place_furniture. If blocked is true, ask the user to paste the product page text and call read_product again with that text as input. Never guess millimeters; a missing dimension is listed in missing.

input.description: A product URL, or the pasted text of the product page.

tools.name: create_room
tools.description: Free, no key. Creates a new plan at scale 1:50 and returns its project id plus purchase_url. Send name, plus either width_m and depth_m (rectangle) or rectangles (L-shape, alcove, bay), never both. Always send openings in this same call; without openings the checker treats the room as having no doors and skips the door-swing check. Each side 0.3 to 200 m. Coordinates: x to the right, y down, origin at the room's top-left corner.

name.description: Name of the plan, e.g. Living room. Default My room.

width_m.description: Width in meters (left to right), 0.3 to 200.

depth_m.description: Depth in meters (top to bottom), 0.3 to 200.

openings.description: All doors and windows of the room. The swing area of every door becomes a blocked area that furniture must keep clear.

wall.description: The wall the opening sits in, as seen on the plan.

center.description: Center of the opening in meters along that wall, measured from the wall's top-left end: from the left end on the top and bottom walls, from the top end on the left and right walls.

width.description: Width in meters, 0.4 to 6. Default 0.9 for a door, 1.2 for a window.

hinge.description: Doors only: the end that carries the hinges, default left. Omit for windows.

rectangles.description: Instead of width_m and depth_m: 1 to 12 partial areas in meters. kind add joins the area, kind cut removes it. x, y is the rectangle's top-left corner, w, h its size.

key.description: Purchase token rp_ plus 20 characters, from the purchase confirmation. Required on projects you created, not on beispiel-wohnzimmer. Not the project id.

tools.name: place_furniture
tools.description: Places furniture and returns the checked plan as an image plus placed, rejected, issues and image_prompt. Send exactly one of spots, placement, or wish. Prefer spots: you name each piece and a rough position (at), the server finds the exact spot, snaps to a 5 cm grid and avoids walls, doors and other pieces. Use placement only when the user gives exact positions; never invent x, y or rot. Use wish only when the user describes the room without naming pieces; it calls Roomproof's own model, is slower and less predictable. Every way is checked against the floor area, overlaps, blocked areas and a 0.9 m path; what does not fit comes back in rejected with a reason. Dimensions in millimeters; x and y in meters to the CENTER of the piece, from the room's top-left corner. Needs key on your own project, free on beispiel-wohnzimmer (nothing is saved there).

project.description: Plan id from create_room, or beispiel-wohnzimmer.

spots.description: Preferred. 1 to 40 pieces, each with catalog or with name plus width_mm and depth_mm, plus at. Larger pieces are placed first.

catalog.description: Catalog id from show_catalog, an ASCII slug such as sofa-3-plaetzer. Copy it, never translate or invent it.

name.description: Custom piece instead of catalog, e.g. from read_product. Then width_mm and depth_mm are required.

width_mm.description: Width in millimeters (a sofa is 1600 to 2600, never 2.0), 50 to 10000. The longer side seen from the front.

depth_mm.description: Depth in millimeters, 50 to 10000. The side going into the room.

height_mm.description: Height in millimeters, if known. Custom pieces only.

price.description: Price from read_product, unchanged. Custom pieces only.

link.description: Product link from read_product, unchanged. Custom pieces only.

at.description: Rough position, exactly one of: wall:top, wall:bottom, wall:left, wall:right, corner:top-left, corner:top-right, corner:bottom-left, corner:bottom-right, near:door, near:<piece name from this list>, free. Default free.

placement.description: Exact positions from the user, 1 to 60 pieces. Each with catalog or with name plus width_mm and depth_mm, plus x, y (meters to the piece center) and rot. Nothing is nudged: a piece that sticks out or overlaps is rejected.

catalog.description: Catalog id from show_catalog, an ASCII slug such as sofa-3-plaetzer. Copy it, never translate or invent it.

name.description: Custom piece instead of catalog, e.g. from read_product. Then width_mm and depth_mm are required.

width_mm.description: Width in millimeters (a sofa is 1600 to 2600, never 2.0), 50 to 10000. The longer side seen from the front.

depth_mm.description: Depth in millimeters, 50 to 10000. The side going into the room.

height_mm.description: Height in millimeters, if known. Custom pieces only.

price.description: Price from read_product, unchanged. Custom pieces only.

link.description: Product link from read_product, unchanged. Custom pieces only.

x.description: Piece center, horizontal, in meters from the left wall.

y.description: Piece center, vertical, in meters from the top wall.

rot.description: Rotation in degrees clockwise, default 0. 90 turns the width along the left/right walls.

wish.description: One sentence describing the room, e.g. a living room for four with a reading corner. Only without spots and placement.

keep.description: Default false: the new pieces replace everything in the plan. true adds them to the pieces already there.

name.description: Name of the saved variant, default Draft.

outdoor.description: With wish only: limit the model to outdoor furniture, for terraces and balconies.

blocked.description: Rectangles that must stay free (radiator, wall cupboard, walkway): x, y, w, h in meters from the room's top-left corner, not piece centers. Door swings are added automatically.

name.description: Shown on the plan, e.g. Radiator.

key.description: Purchase token rp_ plus 20 characters, from the purchase confirmation. Required on projects you created, not on beispiel-wohnzimmer. Not the project id.

tools.name: set_door
tools.description: Replaces the full openings list of a project you created (an empty list removes all). Windows have no hinge. Until openings exist, door-swing clearance is not checked. Saved layouts may get new issues afterwards; run check_plan. Needs key; not available on beispiel-wohnzimmer.

openings.description: All doors and windows of the room, 0 to 20. Replaces the existing list completely.

wall.description: The wall the opening sits in, as seen on the plan.

center.description: Center of the opening in meters along that wall, measured from the wall's top-left end: from the left end on the top and bottom walls, from the top end on the left and right walls.

width.description: Width in meters, 0.4 to 6. Default 0.9 for a door, 1.2 for a window.

hinge.description: Doors only: the end that carries the hinges, default left. Omit for windows.

key.description: Purchase token rp_ plus 20 characters, from the purchase confirmation. Required on projects you created, not on beispiel-wohnzimmer. Not the project id.

tools.name: show_catalog
tools.description: Free, no key. Lists every piece Roomproof knows: catalog id (ASCII slug, copy it exactly), display name, width_mm, depth_mm, group. Call it with no group first. Custom pieces (name plus width_mm and depth_mm, e.g. from read_product) do not need the catalog.

group.description: Optional filter. Must be one of the strings in groups from a previous show_catalog response, e.g. Living or Outdoor.

tools.name: move_furniture
tools.description: Moves, rotates or removes one piece in the saved layout and returns the re-checked plan as an image with issues. Send x and y together (piece center, meters), rot, or remove true. The result is saved even with issues, so read them and move again if needed. Needs key on your own project, free on beispiel-wohnzimmer (not saved).

project.description: Plan id from create_room, or beispiel-wohnzimmer.

variant.description: Variant id from a previous response; default the newest.

piece.description: Display name from placed, furniture or issues in the last place_furniture, show_plan or check_plan response, e.g. 3-seat sofa. Not the catalog id.

index.description: If several pieces share the name: which one, counted from 1 in list order. Default 1.

x.description: New piece center, horizontal, in meters. Send with y.

y.description: New piece center, vertical, in meters. Send with x.

remove.description: true removes the piece; x, y and rot are then ignored.

key.description: Purchase token rp_ plus 20 characters, from the purchase confirmation. Required on projects you created, not on beispiel-wohnzimmer. Not the project id.

tools.name: show_plan
tools.description: Returns the saved plan as an image drawn to scale, plus image_prompt and image_positions. For a photo of the room copy image_prompt verbatim into your own image generator; Roomproof does not render photos. Needs key on your own project, free on beispiel-wohnzimmer.

project.description: Plan id from create_room, or beispiel-wohnzimmer.

variant.description: Variant id from a previous response; default the newest.

key.description: Purchase token rp_ plus 20 characters, from the purchase confirmation. Required on projects you created, not on beispiel-wohnzimmer. Not the project id.

tools.name: check_plan
tools.description: Re-checks the saved layout only: pieces sticking out, overlaps, blocked areas including door swings, and a 0.9 m path to every piece. Does not place, move or spend a wish. Call it after move_furniture or when issues are unclear; ok true with an empty issues list is the condition for open_plan. Needs key on your own project, free on beispiel-wohnzimmer.

project.description: Plan id from create_room, or beispiel-wohnzimmer.

variant.description: Variant id from a previous response; default the newest.

key.description: Purchase token rp_ plus 20 characters, from the purchase confirmation. Required on projects you created, not on beispiel-wohnzimmer. Not the project id.

tools.name: open_plan
tools.description: Call only after the last check_plan returned no issues. Returns view_url (read-only, to share) and edit_url (for the owner, with the scaled PDF download). Needs key; not available on beispiel-wohnzimmer.

new.description: true creates a new view_url and invalidates the previous share link. Only if the user wants that.

key.description: Purchase token rp_ plus 20 characters, from the purchase confirmation. Required on projects you created, not on beispiel-wohnzimmer. Not the project id.
